verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs and product pages document rich AI-generated insight generation from codebase data — automated PR reviews, confidence scores, sequence diagrams, auto-generated tests, and a runtime sandbox (TREX) that surfaces bugs with logs/screenshots — and later community reports (comm-8) describe it catching real issues in production use. However, earlier hands-on community reports directly contradict reliability of these insights: users reported repos that never finished processing, internal errors on every query, and answers on real codebases being 'incomplete and usually partly or mostly incorrect' even when the answer was in the code. Missing for 10: independent recent benchmarks validating insight accuracy at scale, and resolution of these documented failure reports.
